prompt: A mudhorn (Mudhorn), a Star Wars canon creature. Mudhorns were large horned creatures that originated from the planet Arvala-7. The eggs of mudhorns were considered a delicacy by Jawas. It was this reason that populations of these creatures were established on other worlds as a result of unscrupulous bartering deals. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
